connector.notes: Moves this computer to the new TallyFlow server address. Nothing about how it reads Tally has changed. Marked mandatory because the old address is being retired: a connector that skipped this build would keep dialling a name that stops answering, and could not then be reached to be told anything.

android.notes: A tighter layout throughout -- more rows on screen without scrolling. Fixes a dashboard that came up blank when the period had something to compare against. Points at the new server address.
